labels: One hand grips the locker handle as the door stands open on its hinge, and the free hand reaches toward a book inside the revealed compartment.; 한 손이 사물함 손잡이를 잡고 문은 경첩을 축으로 열려 있으며 반대 손이 드러난 칸 안 책으로 향한다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: One hand grips the locker handle as the door stands open on its hinge, and the free hand reaches toward a book inside the revealed compartment.
